title: Federation mailbox participation test path needs 1.5–2 MiB of stack on master; reduce its deepest stack use
outcome: On master, tests::federation_mailbox_participation::qualified_existing_roots_exchange_read_and_ack_without_join_or_activation needs between 1.5 and 2 MiB of test-thread stack in the debug build, so any small growth of a future on that path overflows the default 2 MiB stack. The large future or futures on that path (the qualified pair's sends, reads and acknowledgements through the federation RPC client and receiver, awaited inline on a current_thread runtime) are found and moved to the heap, for example with Box::pin, with no behaviour, timeout or limit change and without raising any stack size. Afterwards the test passes at the default stack and, as evidence of reclaimed headroom, also under RUST_MIN_STACK=1572864.
acceptance: tests::federation_mailbox_participation::qualified_existing_roots_exchange_read_and_ack_without_join_or_activation passes with RUST_MIN_STACK=1572864, a margin below the 2 MiB default, and at the default stack, on the host where the RED reproduced. Master 63cdb117 overflows at 1572864 on that host (RED first). Both are shown by registered runs.

The fix reduces the stack the test path uses at its deepest point (for example by moving large locals or futures to the heap, or heavy synchronous work off the deep call stack), with no behaviour, timeout or limit change, and never raises RUST_MIN_STACK or any thread stack. The federation_mailbox_participation module and the federation security, onboarding-deadline and mailbox-timeout tests still pass.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
